text:
Alex C.: @channel quick sync — Cortina Health renewal hits 6/30 and procurement just flagged a tax ID mismatch on the invoice entity. Need a plan. :wave:
Maria F.: Ugh. Which entity are they trying to pay from?
Devon S.: Cortina is splitting across Cortina Inc (US) and Cortina EU (EMEA). PO came from Cortina Inc but billing entity on our contract is Cortina Health LLC.
Olivia O.: They also asked to move the onboarding kickoff earlier — want the new seat expansion trained before the renewal date. 45 seats total if we approve the addon.
Alex C.: Current contract = 30 seats. Sales wants price protection for existing seats, add-on seats at list. We need PO + corrected tax ID to process.
Maria F.: Finance requires either a new PO matching the billed entity or an invoice entity amendment. We can't accept PO-987654 as-is. Can procurement get a revised PO? @procure-bot any standard phrasing we can send?
procure-bot: Suggested message to buyer:
```
Please reissue the PO naming "Cortina Health LLC" (EIN: 12-3456789) as the billing entity and reference PO-987654 as the original request. Attach company W-9 for US payments.
```
Devon S.: I'll ping the buyer. Also negotiating net30 instead of net45 — they asked for net60 but finance said no.
Priya L.: Legal: if they can't reissue the PO we can do an amendment to change invoice entity, but that needs exec signoff and will take 2 business days. Would that block the onboarding slot?
Olivia O.: We can hold one onboarding slot tentatively for the week of 6/24 if they confirm seat counts by 6/21. If we must wait for amendment we risk missing that slot.
Alex C.: Proposed path: ask for reissued PO today (fast). If buyer can't, route a 1-page entity amendment to DocuSign and we expedite signature. Devon — ask buyer for timeline and whether procurement can reissue by COB today.
Devon S.: On it. Message sent: "Can procurement reissue PO to Cortina Health LLC (EIN provided)? If not, we will send a one-page amendment via DocuSign to align invoice entity and preserve onboarding next week."
Maria F.: Financial note: seat true-up from 30 -> 45 prorates on 6/30. Example prorate calc I sent last renewal: 
```
30 seats -> 45 seats add 15 seats
Monthly list seat = $150
Prorate (6/30) = full month for add-on = 15 * $150 = $2,250
```
Alex C.: Add that calc to the amendment and the quote. Attach training cost separately.
Priya L.: I'll draft the amendment and flag for exec quick sign. Share draft in #legal-review once ready.
procure-bot: DocuSign template queued: AMEND-ENTITY-ONEPAGER v2. Will populate with EIN and prorate.
Devon S.: Buyer replied: procurement can reissue PO but needs our billing tax ID on an invoice sample. They want a PDF sample now.
Maria F.: Uploading sample invoice with our billing tax ID and VAT notes. Sending to buyer now.
Olivia O.: Buyer confirmed they can reissue by EOD if we provide sample and seat counts. I'll lock a tentative slot but mark as "requires PO".
Alex C.: Good. Action items: Devon — confirm PO reissue + send sample invoice (done), Priya — draft amendment if needed, Maria — prep final quote + prorate lines, Olivia — hold onboarding slot tentatively. I'll update thread when PO lands or amendment sent. :thumbsup:
Devon S.: PO reissued incoming — buyer attached PO-987654-reissued.pdf (matches Cortina Health LLC). Forwarding now.
Alex C.: Perfect. Once finance confirms invoice can be processed, we close renewal loop. Thanks team.
